description: This file provides utilities for rate limiting, including a token bucket implementation and a GitHub-specific rate limiter that adjusts delays based on GitHub API headers. It facilitates controlled API request pacing with support for backoff strategies, useful in managing GitHub API rate limits.

classes.name: TokenBucket
classes.description: Implements a token bucket algorithm for rate limiting actions, allowing tokens to refill over time and providing a blocking acquire method.

classes.name: GitHubRateLimiter
classes.description: Wraps a TokenBucket and adapts to GitHub API rate limit headers, adjusting request pacing and providing backoff strategies based on API responses.

methods.name: TokenBucket.__init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing rate per second, capacity, and optional custom time and sleep functions.

methods.name: TokenBucket._refill
methods.description: Refills tokens based on elapsed time since last refill.

methods.name: TokenBucket.acquire
methods.description: Blocks until one token is available for use.

methods.name: GitHubRateLimiter.__init__
methods.description: Constructor associating a token bucket with the rate limiter, including optional sleep and time functions.

methods.name: GitHubRateLimiter.acquire
methods.description: Requests permission to proceed via the underlying token bucket.

methods.name: GitHubRateLimiter.update_from_headers
methods.description: Adjusts pacing based on GitHub rate limit headers, sleeping until reset if necessary.

methods.name: GitHubRateLimiter.backoff_on_throttle
methods.description: Implements exponential backoff with jitter upon receiving rate limit signals.

methods.name: GitHubRateLimiter.reset_backoff
methods.description: Resets the backoff state after successful requests.
